# Langfuse Provider

Manage Langfuse organizations, projects, API keys, memberships, and LLM connections with Terraform or OpenTofu. Organization management requires an Enterprise-enabled Langfuse instance and an admin API key. Project and membership resources use organization-scoped keys; LLM connections use project-scoped keys.

## Authentication

| Scope | Configuration | Used by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Admin | `admin_api_key` or `LANGFUSE_ADMIN_KEY` | Organizations and organization API keys |
| Organization | Resource `organization_public_key` and `organization_private_key` | Projects, project API keys, and memberships |
| Project | Resource `project_public_key` and `project_secret_key` | LLM connections |

`host` is configured in the provider block; it does not read `LANGFUSE_HOST`.
An Enterprise license is configured on the Langfuse server, not in this provider.

## Security and lifecycle

Sensitive attributes hide values in CLI output but still store them in state.
Use an encrypted, access-controlled state backend and do not commit state files.
API key secrets and LLM credentials cannot be recovered from the API after
creation; retain their configuration and state securely.

The Terraform and OpenTofu registry listings for this fork are pending.
The historical `langfuse/langfuse` registry address refers to upstream, not
this fork. Follow the repository's local-development instructions until
publication is complete.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    langfuse = {
      source = "langfuse/langfuse" # Local development override, not a registry install.
    }
  }
}

variable "langfuse_host" {
  type        = string
  description = "Base URL of your Langfuse instance."
}

provider "langfuse" {
  host = var.langfuse_host
  # Organization management reads the admin key from LANGFUSE_ADMIN_KEY.
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `admin_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Admin API key. Only needed when managing organizations. Can also come from LANGFUSE_ADMIN_KEY.
- `host` (String) Base URI of the Langfuse instance (defaults to https://app.langfuse.com).
